user.title: Connect to LeChange
user.description:
Enter your LeChange app account and choose a login method.

⚠️ This integration relies on an unofficial reverse-engineered protocol for personal use/research only. No warranty is provided and you accept all account/usage risks (see the disclaimer in the README).

password.title: Password login
password.description: Logging in as {username}; enter your LeChange app password.

sms.title: SMS code login
sms.description:
Account {username}: first get an SMS code in the **LeChange app** (SMS login / forgot-password page), then enter the 6-digit code.

(The integration also tries to send one; in practice unauthenticated sends are blocked by server anti-abuse (11010) — use the app if none arrives.)

gt4.title: Human verification (GT4 slider)

credit.title: Terminal authorization
credit.description:
Account {username} has "terminal management" enabled; a new device must be authorized on first login. A verification code has been sent to your phone — enter the 6-digit SMS code to authorize this terminal.

(After authorization this terminal can log in normally. If no SMS arrives, retry or check the terminal-management settings in the app.)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate LeChange account
reauth_confirm.description:
Logins for account {username} are blocked by LeChange "terminal management" (terminal authorization changed). Re-enter the password and complete one terminal authorization — the integration will recover seamlessly.

(Entities, history and configuration are all preserved; no device re-adding.)

device.title: Select Device
device.description:
Select the lock device to add.

**Security code** (optional): the 8-character uppercase code printed next to the QR/barcode on the device label (battery compartment), also shown in App > Device settings > About, or on the box. Only needed for alarm snapshot decryption — **can be left empty and added later**.

**Device password** (optional): the current password after changing it in the LeChange app; if never changed it equals the security code — **leave empty**.

Both credentials are stored locally and can be added or changed anytime via Settings > Devices & Services > LeChange Door Lock > Configure.

data.security_code: Security code (8 chars, device label; optional)
data.device_password: Device password (only if changed; empty = same as security code)

error.sms_needed: This account requires an SMS/two-step code; switch to the SMS-code login method.
error.captcha_needed: Anti-abuse / human verification (Geetest GT4) triggered. Complete one slider check in the **LeChange app** to unlock the account, then retry.
error.no_devices: No devices found under this account.
error.security_code_invalid: Security code should be 8 uppercase letters/digits (see device label).
error.credit_failed: Terminal authorization failed. Check the code and retry.

abort.gt4_unavailable: GT4 slider service is not available. Restart Home Assistant and retry.
abort.gt4_timeout: GT4 slider timed out (no valid tuple received within 5 minutes).
abort.gt4_failed: GT4 verification failed. Check the log for details and retry.
abort.credit_unavailable: Terminal authorization is unavailable: failed to load client credentials (OEM AK/SK). Update the integration or check env LECHANGE_OEM_AK/LECHANGE_OEM_SK.
abort.credit_send_failed: Failed to send the authorization SMS code. Retry later.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful. The integration has recovered.
abort.reauth_failed: Re-authentication failed: the matching config entry was not found. Please remove and re-add the integration.

init.title: Integration options
init.description: Credentials, door-front snapshots and connection mode. Everything can be changed later; takes effect immediately after saving.

data_description.device_password: The original device password is the machine's security code. If you never changed it, just enter the security code here. After changing it in the LeChange app, enter the current value. Used for live stream frame decryption (snapshots/preview); leave empty to keep current.
data_description.snapshot_min_interval: Minimum interval between cloud door-front snapshots (15-3600s, default 60). Stream requests wake the battery lock; lower = more drain. Only throttles camera polling; manual service calls bypass it.
data_description.snapshot_stream_id: Main stream (recommended; verified to carry data on the relay); sub stream saves bandwidth but the relay carries no data and auto-falls back to main.
data_description.snapshot_osd: Burn timestamp (top-left) and channel name (bottom-right) onto snapshots. Off = clean original frame.
data_description.snapshot_osd_alpha: Watermark background darkness 0-255 (default 160 = ~63% translucent). 0 = fully transparent, 255 = solid black.
data_description.camera_auto_image: Master switch, default OFF: when off, camera entities stop fetching images automatically — cloud streams wake the battery lock and LAN snapshots keep the device active; both drain the battery. Off = zero automatic wake from camera cards (last cached frame is shown); the snapshot button and services still work manually. On = dashboard camera cards auto-refresh at the throttle interval (costs battery).
data_description.channel_hosts: Local direct addresses, one per line "channel=IP[:port]". Examples — single camera / main only: 0=192.168.1.10:80 ; both cameras: 0=192.168.1.10:80 and 1=192.168.1.10:80 (port = device HTTP port, Dahua default 80, optional). When the device is on your LAN, snapshots/preview connect directly (no cloud, faster); leave empty = cloud only, auto-falls back to cloud when offline.
data_description.stream_preview_osd: Burn timestamp and channel name onto live preview/recordings (default on).
data_description.stream_preview_seconds: Single live-preview capture length 3-60s (default 10). The device stays awake during capture.
data_description.rtsp_url: Full RTSP URL template, '{'channel'}' is replaced by the channel number (0=main, 1=secondary). Examples — go2rtc/ffmpeg relay: rtsp://192.168.1.5:8554/doorlock (without the placeholder both cameras share this address) ; Dahua native: rtsp://admin:password@192.168.1.10:554/cam/realmonitor?channel='{'channel'}'&subtype=0 (note the replacement is 0/1; if the device numbers channels from 1, build two streams in go2rtc instead). When set, the camera entity hands it to the HA stream component and skips cloud streaming; leave empty = cloud mode.
data_description.rtsp_host: The lock's LAN IP (with credentials below, used for CGI snapshot). Empty = pure cloud mode (recommended; no device RTSP needed).
data_description.rtsp_password: Device RTSP/CGI password (device credential, unrelated to your LeChange app account).
data_description.rtsp_subtype: 0 = main stream (HD, default), 1 = sub stream (smooth). Only affects the RTSP/CGI direct path.
